annotations.title: Boat or yacht loan payment, balloon, tax and insurance

description: Runs the yacht.loans boat loan calculator on your numbers: monthly loan payment, payment with insurance, amount financed, balloon left at the end when payments are figured over more years than the term, interest over the term, sales tax (from a state rule on the site or your own rate and cap), cash at closing, and the loan balance at the end of each year.

amortization_years.description: Years the payments are figured over. Default = term_years (no balloon). Longer than the term leaves a balloon, e.g. term 15 figured over 20. Shorter than the term is raised to the term, as on the site.

apr_pct.description: APR in percent from the borrower's own quote, e.g. 8.25. This server has no rate of its own; lenders' published ranges are in list_boat_lender_terms.

closing_costs.description: Documentation, title and registration costs in dollars. Default 0.

down_payment.description: Down payment in dollars. Default 0. Give this or down_payment_pct, not both.

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment as a percent of the price, e.g. 20. Give this or down_payment, not both.

finance_tax_and_fees.description: Roll the sales tax and closing costs into the loan (true, default, as on the site) or pay them at closing (false).

insurance_per_year.description: Annual insurance premium in dollars from the agent's quote. Default 0.

price.description: Purchase price of the boat in US dollars, e.g. 450000.

sales_tax_cap.description: Maximum sales tax in dollars with sales_tax_pct, 0 = no cap. Default 0.

sales_tax_pct.description: Your own sales tax rate in percent, used when state is omitted. Default 0.

state.description: Two-letter code of the state where the boat is taxed; applies that state's rate and cap from https://yacht.loans/boat-sales-tax-by-state/. Usable: CT, FL, MD, NJ, NC, RI, SC, TX, VA. Omit to give sales_tax_pct instead.

term_years.description: Loan term in years, e.g. 15 (the site offers 5, 7, 10, 12, 15 and 20).
